answer: Each new agent must post a bond of 10 ONYX tokens to an on‑chain escrow contract that references a signed Quill certificate issued by a trusted Cedar authority; the bond is locked for a 48‑hour challenge window. If any node submits proof that the certificate duplicates an existing identity, the contract auto‑claws back the bond to the challenger and blacklists the impostor. The attacker therefore pays 10 ONYX per fake identity plus the 48‑hour lock‑up, making mass Sybil creation financially prohibitive.
